text:
taylor_sales: Kicking off client X hybrid POC. They want PrivateLink into their VPC and an onprem Palo Alto performing TLS inspect. Need options: preserve client IP vs SNAT, firewall allowlist, and quick cost sketch.

rita_solutions: Timeline? qps/seq?

taylor_sales: 2-week POC, low qps. They have BGP at colo and can peer TGW but security prefers PrivateLink.

omar_netops: Note: PrivateLink endpoints are ENIs in their VPC and our NLB will SNAT egress. To preserve original client IP to onprem inspect you need a transit path (TGW + DirectConnect/VPN with BGP) or an appliance in their VPC forwarding traffic. PrivateLink alone won't keep src IP across our NAT.

lee_se: Two pragmatic POC approaches:
- Option 1 (fast): PrivateLink + our static EIP egress. Their Palo Alto sees our EIP as the client.
- Option 2 (preserve IP): TGW/VPN + BGP announce so we can preserve source addresses; longer lead time and approvals.

sec-bot: checklist: provide SOC2 attestation, KMS/HSM options, audit log retention (90d), TLS cipher policy, and confirm customer IP handling (transient logs, redacted before long-term storage).

taylor_sales: Can we provide a minimal Palo Alto allowlist for the POC?

rita_solutions: Example allowlist to give them:
- Allow TCP/443 from app-subnets -> interface endpoint ENI IPs
- Allow established/related return traffic
- If using our EIP egress: allow TCP/443 from our static EIP(s) to onprem TLS box
- Optional ICMP for health checks
Replace IP placeholders after we provision.

omar_netops: Scale note: PrivateLink ENI/NLB connection limits. For low qps POC OK; call out concurrency limits for production.

taylor_sales: Pricing ask: ballpark for small reserved capacity + 2 EIPs for POC?

lee_se: Ballpark reserved pool ~$6k-$10k/mo depending on model; EIP costs are AWS charges + ops time. Use an estimate line item and we'll refine after qps.

taylor_sales: Action items: lee -> cost sketch by EOD; rita -> firewall snippet + questionnaire draft; omar -> confirm BGP announce feasibility and approx lead time. Customer call tomorrow 09:00 PT  please have one SME.
